versions.subject: new rules accompanying Follina exploits
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
  ParentImage|endswith:
    - '\powershell.exe'
    - '\cmd.exe'
    - '\mshta.exe'
    - '\cscript.exe'
    - '\wscript.exe'
    - '\wsl.exe'
    # office apps are covered by other rules
selection_msdt:
  - Image|endswith: '\msdt.exe'
  - OriginalFileName: 'msdt.exe'
condition: all of selection_*
